summary: Kimi Antonelli arrives at Circuit of the Americas with pole position and the championship within reach, needing only to manage a dominant pace advantage over his pursuers to potentially clinch the title on Sunday. Charles Leclerc's Friday practice pace signals Ferrari's intent to disrupt Mercedes' coronation plans, setting up a critical battle for track position through the opening corners. A victory here would crown Antonelli the youngest F1 world champion in history, fundamentally reshaping the sport's generational narrative in a single afternoon in Austin.
